oneLine: StockGro confidentially files IPO papers and eyes up to a Rs 2,500 crore issue.

sources.title: StockGro Confidentially Files IPO Papers, Eyes Up To ₹2,500 Cr Issue
StockGro Parent Files Confidential IPO Papers for Rs 2,500 Crore

synopsis: Investment advisory startup StockGro's parent AssetGro Fintech Ltd pre-filed its draft red herring prospectus with SEBI, BSE, and NSE under the confidential pre-filing route on September 26. StockGro is looking to raise up to Rs 2,000 Cr to Rs 2,500 Cr via the IPO, which includes a fresh issue of around Rs 800 Cr and an offer for sale by existing shareholders. The final issue size and structure could change during the IPO process.
